identity.operation: xmlXIncludeProcessNode processes the document URL in xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot.
identity.condition: An injected allocation failure occurs while copying the document URL.
identity.capability: xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc) must expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure.
identity.consequence: The failure flag is set while xinc->errNo remains zero, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.

requirement: For an injected allocation failure during xmlXIncludeProcessNode, the existing check must see XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc), or use another valid existing indication of that failure.

assessment.requirement: For an injected allocation failure during the document URL copy in xmlXIncludeDoProcessRoot, the existing xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure check must receive XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through xmlXIncludeGetLastError(xinc), or another existing valid indication of that same failure.
assessment.target_route: The entry parses a main entity with a supplied URL, creates an XInclude context, calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode, and checks xinc->errNo. ProcessNode delegates to root processing, whose document URL copy runs only when tree->doc and tree->doc->URL are non-NULL. Whether that guard and an injected allocation failure coincide is not fully established.
assessment.failure_condition: If the document URL copy fails through the injected allocator, xmlXIncludeErrMemory reports to xmlRaiseMemoryError with a NULL error pointer and leaves xinc->errNo unchanged. The existing check would then compare a set allocation-failure flag with a false XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY expectation and abort.
assessment.alternative_paths: The root function returns on URL copy failure before include traversal. The harness does not use ProcessNode's return or the global last error for this check; its later copy and reader calls follow the check. These alternatives do not repair the conditional mismatch.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The harness's parser call forwards the supplied URL.
The parser copies the URL to its input filename and returns a well-formed document, but this does not itself show doc->URL.
ProcessNode validates arguments and invokes root processing.
The guarded document URL copy calls the memory reporter and returns before traversal on failure.
The delegated reporter updates the global error and only updates a separate error object when its pointer is non-NULL.
A successful XInclude context starts with errNo zero.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: An injected allocation failure sets fuzzAllocFailed.
The selected allocation limit resets the flag, and the existing check aborts when the flag differs from its expectation.

missing_information: The complete xmlSAX2StartDocument function in SAX2.c and xmlInitSAXParserCtxt in parserInternals.c for the document URL propagation route.

necessity_evidence.reason: The packet establishes that the existing assertion would abort if the document URL copy encounters an injected allocation failure. It does not establish that a valid fuzz input produces a document with a non-NULL doc->URL or that the copy reaches the injected allocator under the supplied build. The finite target execution is therefore unproved.

scope_contract.reason: The old entry calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode and checks its context error code. That operation delegates to the document URL copy.

feasible_trigger.reason: The harness can supply a URL and select an allocation index, but the supplied parser code does not show that the parsed document receives doc->URL. The supplied xmlStrdup body delegates to an unread xmlStrndup body. The relevant build defaults are also unread.

evidence.dependency_reason: Fuzz input supplies the main URL and entity.
The parser forwards the supplied URL.
The parser copies the URL to the input filename, which does not itself prove doc->URL is set.
The URL copy delegates to xmlStrndup, whose allocation behavior is not supplied.
A selected allocator call can set the failure flag.

observable_consequence.reason: Conditional on that copy failing through the injected allocator, the new memory reporter updates no XInclude context error field. The context starts with errNo zero, the getter returns that field, and the existing assertion aborts on a mismatch.

evidence.dependency_reason: A NULL error pointer leaves any context error object untouched; the reporter updates the global error.
The existing check aborts when the failure flag differs from its expected value.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: For this conditional URL-copy failure, root processing returns before include traversal. The existing check uses neither ProcessNode's return nor the global last error; later operations follow the check.

evidence.dependency_reason: The reporter's global error is a separate indication that the existing check does not read.

identity_preserved.reason: The before and after evidence concerns the same root URL-copy failure and the same old harness check. The removed reporter set ctxt->errNo; the added reporter does not. This supports a conditional change in outcome, although trigger feasibility remains unknown.
